items.en: US Supreme Court hands Trump a ruling that analysts call a gift in disguise
items.zh: 美國最高法院做出對川普有利的裁決，但分析指其為「包裝成禮物的負擔」—— 短期法律勝利可能反而擴大行政權爭議、埋下後續訴訟
items.summary: The US Supreme Court issued a ruling in Donald Trump's favour that commentators describe as a gift in disguise. The decision hands the administration a short-term legal win, but analysts argue it simultaneously enlarges the constitutional questions surrounding executive power and invites a further wave of litigation. Coverage emphasises that the practical consequences may run against the administration's interests over a longer horizon, because the reasoning the court adopted can be applied by opponents in subsequent cases. The ruling lands amid several parallel legal battles involving tariffs, federal appointments and agency authority.

items.en: Trump raises new global tariffs to 15% as legal fights over refunds loom
items.zh: 川普將新一輪全球關稅調高至 15% —— 退稅訴訟同時逼近，進口商面臨成本與法律雙重不確定性
items.summary: President Trump has raised the new across-the-board global tariff rate to 15%, escalating a trade policy that is already the subject of litigation. The increase arrives while courts weigh whether earlier tariff collections must be refunded, leaving importers exposed to both higher immediate costs and unresolved legal uncertainty over money already paid. Analysts link the tariff path directly to the inflation picture, noting that goods prices feed into consumer price data with a lag. Businesses say the combination of a moving rate and pending refund cases makes pricing and inventory planning unusually difficult.

items.en: US intelligence ties a Chinese explosive test to a push for an entirely new nuclear arsenal
items.zh: 美國情報機構將中國一次爆炸試驗與「打造全新核武庫」的計畫連結 —— 評估指向彈頭設計世代更替，而非既有庫存維護
items.summary: US intelligence agencies have linked a Chinese explosive test to what they assess is an effort to develop a completely new nuclear arsenal rather than maintain the existing stockpile. The assessment points to work on new warhead designs, implying a generational change in China’s strategic forces rather than incremental modernisation. The finding is likely to intensify debate in Washington over arms control, testing moratoria and the pace of the US modernisation programme. Officials cited in the reporting stress that the evidence concerns design development, and the story sits against a wider backdrop of strained US-China security relations.

items.en: Death of a far-right activist in France sends tensions soaring and draws US criticism
items.zh: 法國一名極右派運動人士死亡，國內緊張急遽升高並引來美方批評 —— 事件迅速從治安問題升級為跨大西洋外交摩擦
items.summary: The death of a far-right activist in France has sharply raised domestic political tensions and drawn public criticism from the United States. What began as a domestic law-and-order incident has escalated quickly into a transatlantic diplomatic irritant, with American officials commenting on French handling of the case. French authorities face pressure from several directions at once: street mobilisation by sympathisers, counter-demonstrations, and scrutiny of the circumstances of the death itself. Analysts note the episode feeds an already polarised French political environment and risks becoming a reference point in European debates about political violence.

items.en: Slovakia threatens to cut electricity to Ukraine unless Kyiv resumes piping Russian oil
items.zh: 斯洛伐克威脅斷供烏克蘭電力，除非基輔恢復輸送俄羅斯石油 —— 能源互賴被直接當成談判籌碼
items.summary: Slovakia has threatened to halt electricity exports to Ukraine unless Kyiv resumes the transit of Russian oil through its territory. The move turns mutual energy dependence into an explicit bargaining lever: Ukraine relies on imported power to stabilise a grid repeatedly damaged by strikes, while Slovakia depends on the pipeline flow for refinery feedstock. The threat exposes the fragility of EU unity on Russian energy, since member states differ sharply on how quickly to sever remaining links. Brussels faces pressure to mediate before the dispute affects Ukrainian supply through the coming winter.

items.en: India opens what it bills as the world's biggest AI summit
items.zh: 印度開幕自稱「全球規模最大」的 AI 高峰會 —— 焦點在於會後能否轉成具體的治理與投資承諾
items.summary: India has opened what organisers describe as the world's biggest AI summit, bringing together governments, model developers and investors. The gathering positions India as a convening power in AI governance rather than only a market, and showcases its push to host compute capacity and build sovereign models. Coverage focuses on the gap between scale and substance: the headline question is whether the summit produces binding commitments on safety, compute access and cross-border data rules, or ends as a showcase. Delegates also discuss the economics of serving AI to very large, price-sensitive user bases.

items.en: New AI technology from a Chinese developer rattles the global industry
items.zh: 一家中國開發商的新 AI 技術撼動全球產業 —— 市場再次重新評估「前沿模型到底需要多少資本」這個前提
items.summary: New AI technology released by a Chinese developer has unsettled the global industry, prompting a fresh round of questions about how much capital a frontier-class capability actually requires. The episode echoes earlier shocks in which an unexpected release from outside the established US labs forced investors to re-price assumptions about training costs, chip demand and competitive moats. Commentary focuses on whether the capability claims hold up under independent testing, and on the policy implications for export controls. The story lands in the same week that US chip stocks fell for a seventh consecutive session.

items.en: ASML says AI demand will exceed its planned chip-tool supply for 2027 and 2028
items.zh: ASML：AI 需求將超過 2027、2028 年既定機台供給量，部分客戶已要求預訂 2029–2030 年產能 —— 設備端在喊供不應求，同一週股價端卻在殺 AI 基建
items.summary: ASML has said that AI-driven demand will exceed the chip-making tool supply it has planned for 2027 and 2028, and that some customers are already asking to place orders for 2029 and 2030. The statement, made alongside third-quarter results, is a concrete supply-side datapoint in a debate otherwise dominated by capital-expenditure announcements. Because lithography capacity gates how fast leading-edge fabs can expand, an admission of multi-year tightness carries through the entire chain, from foundries to memory makers. The comment contrasts sharply with the same week’s heavy sell-off in AI infrastructure equities.

items.en: Norway’s Klaebo becomes the first Winter Olympian to win six medals at a single Games
items.zh: 挪威越野滑雪名將 Klæbo 成為史上第一位單屆冬奧奪得六面獎牌的選手 —— 改寫冬季奧運個人單屆紀錄
items.summary: Norway's Johannes Hoesflot Klaebo has become the first Winter Olympian ever to win six medals at a single Games, setting a record above any previous single-Games haul in Winter Olympic history. The achievement reflects both the breadth of the cross-country programme and Klaebo's rare ability to win across sprint and distance formats within the same week. Norwegian dominance in Nordic skiing is long established, but a six-medal individual Games marks a new ceiling for the sport. Coverage frames the record as the defining individual story of these Winter Games.

items.en: USA beat Slovakia in men’s ice hockey to set up a gold-medal showdown with Canada
items.zh: 美國男子冰球擊敗斯洛伐克，晉級金牌戰對上加拿大 —— 北美世仇在奧運決賽再度碰頭
items.summary: The United States beat Slovakia in the men’s Olympic ice hockey semi-final to set up a gold-medal game against Canada, renewing the sport’s most storied rivalry on its biggest stage. With NHL players participating, both rosters are stacked with elite talent, and the final is expected to be the highest-profile event of the tournament. For the United States the match offers a chance to settle a long-running score; for Canada it is a defence of hockey primacy. Broadcasters expect the game to draw the largest North American audience of the Games.

items.en: Alysa Liu wins Olympic figure skating gold — and praise for her style
items.zh: Alysa Liu 奪下奧運花式滑冰金牌 —— 技術分之外，造型與個人風格同樣成為話題
items.summary: Alysa Liu has won Olympic gold in figure skating, capping a comeback story after stepping away from the sport and later returning to competition. Beyond the technical result, coverage highlights her presentation and styling, which drew attention alongside the medal itself. Liu’s victory continues a shift in the discipline toward skaters who pair high technical content with a distinct personal aesthetic. For the United States the gold is a marquee result in a sport where the country had recently struggled to convert strong juniors into senior Olympic titles.

items.en: A study of about 400 college students links daily routine, including breakfast, to stress resilience
items.zh: 約 400 名大學生研究：含早餐在內的「日常規律程度」與壓力承受能力相關 —— 對課表密集的學生最直接可用
items.summary: A Binghamton University study of roughly 400 college students reports that the regularity of daily routines, including whether students eat breakfast, is associated with how well they cope with stress. Students with more consistent daily structure showed better stress-handling outcomes than those whose schedules varied widely from day to day. The researchers frame routine as a modifiable behavioural lever rather than a fixed trait, which matters for interventions on campuses where stress loads are high. As an observational study it cannot prove causation, but the effect was large enough to warrant trials of routine-based interventions.

items.en: Large study finds loneliness and isolation may cost nearly six years of good health
items.zh: 大型研究：孤獨與社會孤立可能讓人少掉將近 6 年「無憂鬱、無焦慮」的健康年數
items.summary: A large study finds that loneliness and social isolation are associated with the loss of nearly six years of life free from depression and anxiety. Rather than reporting only an elevated risk ratio, the researchers express the effect as healthy years lost, which makes the magnitude easier to compare with established risk factors such as smoking or physical inactivity. The finding strengthens the case for treating social connection as a public-health target rather than a purely private matter. The authors caution that reverse causation is possible, since early mental-health symptoms can themselves reduce social contact.

items.en: Researchers identify five distinct brain-activity patterns underlying depression
items.zh: 研究辨識出憂鬱症底下的 5 種不同腦活動模式 —— 263 名患者資料，指向「憂鬱不是單一疾病」
items.summary: Researchers studying 263 people with depression have identified five distinct patterns of brain activity, supporting the view that depression is not a single uniform disorder but a cluster of conditions with different neural signatures. If the subtypes replicate in independent samples, they could help explain why response to a given antidepressant or therapy varies so widely between patients, and could eventually guide treatment selection. The authors stress that the work is a classification step rather than a clinical tool, and that prospective studies are needed before brain-pattern subtyping could inform individual treatment decisions.

items.en: Anthropic licenses Opaque Systems’ confidential-AI technology and hires its team
items.zh: Anthropic 取得 Opaque Systems 機密運算 AI 技術授權並延攬其團隊（含執行長）—— 條件未公開；外傳的 3 億美元是 Opaque 的估值，不是交易價
items.summary: Anthropic has licensed confidential-computing AI technology from Opaque Systems and hired members of its team, including the chief executive, in an arrangement commonly described as an acquihire. Terms were not disclosed. Reports circulating a $300 million figure are citing Opaque's valuation rather than a transaction price, a distinction several outlets flagged. Confidential computing lets models run over sensitive data inside hardware-isolated enclaves, which matters for regulated enterprise customers in finance and healthcare. The move signals that Anthropic is competing on enterprise deployment constraints, not only on raw model capability.

items.en: Ramp’s October index puts Anthropic at 43.8% business adoption versus OpenAI at 40.6%
items.zh: Ramp 10 月企業 AI 採用指數：Anthropic 43.8%、OpenAI 40.6%，但整體 token 支出持平 —— 採用率領先與花費成長是兩件事
items.summary: Ramp's October business AI index reports Anthropic at 43.8% adoption among tracked companies and OpenAI at 40.6%, while aggregate token spending was flat month over month. The flat spend is the more informative number: it suggests enterprise AI budgets are consolidating rather than compounding, even as vendor share shifts. A widely shared claim that Opus 5.5 accounts for 34% of spend comes from a chart posted on X, not from the written report, and should be treated as unverified. Adoption-rate league tables also measure account presence rather than depth of production use.

items.en: Chip-design benchmark: Claude Fable 5.1 leads at 16.6%, while NVIDIA reports a Siemens agent going from 55% to 95%
items.zh: 晶片設計基準 Build-A-Chip-Bench：Claude Fable 5.1 以 16.6% 居首、GPT-6 Astra 8.7% —— 同日 NVIDIA 稱西門子用 NeMo Gym 把晶片特性化代理從約 55% 拉到 95%
items.summary: On Build-A-Chip-Bench, which tests agents end to end from chip specification to layout, Claude Fable 5.1 leads with 16.6% while GPT-6 Astra scores 8.7%. The absolute numbers matter more than the ranking: the best agent still fails more than four fifths of tasks, so full-stack chip design remains well outside current capability. Separately, NVIDIA says Siemens used NeMo Gym feedback to raise a chip-characterisation agent from roughly 55% to 95% while cutting turns by about two thirds, showing that narrow, well-scoped EDA tasks already respond strongly to targeted training.

items.en: Fujii Kaze plays Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31 — still the only Taiwan date on your list
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 10/31 高雄國家體育場 —— **距今 16 天**，仍是清單 16 組歌手中唯一確定有台灣場的一位｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/Fujii%20Kaze
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour reaches Kaohsiung National Stadium on 31 October 2026, now sixteen days away. It remains the only confirmed Taiwan date by any of the sixteen artists on the tracking list, which makes it the single highest-priority item in this section. The tour continues with Fukuoka on 14 and 15 November, Osaka on 10 and 12 to 13 December, Tokyo Dome on 19 and 20 December, and Bangkok on 26 December, with Seoul following in January 2027. The previously scheduled Hong Kong date was cancelled.

items.en: YOASOBI’s 10-city Asia dome and stadium tour names Taipei and Hong Kong, but dates are still unannounced
items.zh: YOASOBI《ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027》確定含**台北**與香港場 —— 但官方至今仍未公布日期與場館，需持續盯｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/YOASOBI
items.summary: YOASOBI has announced a ten-city Asia dome and stadium tour running across 2026 and 2027. Five Japanese cities are named: Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Tokyo. Four overseas cities are confirmed, Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong and Singapore, with one further city still unrevealed. Taipei is the only Taiwan stop. Crucially, no dates, venues or ticketing details have been published for the Taipei or Hong Kong shows, and the announcement says only that more information is coming. Anyone intending to attend should watch the official site rather than resale listings.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE line up a sixth album and their first arena tour in three years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 公布第 6 張專輯與睽違三年的首次巡演 —— 目前公布範圍以日本場為主，尚無台灣場｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/Mrs.%20GREEN%20APPLE
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE have announced a sixth studio album together with their first arena tour in three years. The band has been one of the most commercially dominant acts in Japan over the past two years, so a return to arena touring is a significant scheduling event for the domestic live market. As announced, the routing centres on Japanese arenas, and no Taiwan or Hong Kong date has been confirmed. For anyone tracking the list from Taiwan this is a watch item rather than an actionable one, pending any later announcement of overseas stops.

items.en: No new tour, release or merchandise news in the last 48 hours for the remaining thirteen artists
items.zh: 清單其餘 13 組（Yuuri、YUIKA、Ado、King Gnu、back number、LiSA、Official髭男dism、Aimer、米津玄師、Vaundy、tuki.、RADWIMPS、あいみょん）**過去 48 小時無新巡演／專輯／周邊消息** —— 這是空狀態，不是漏查｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/J-POP
items.summary: For the remaining thirteen artists on the tracking list, no new tour announcements, releases or merchandise news surfaced within the last forty-eight hours. This is reported explicitly as an empty state rather than silently omitted, so the absence is not mistaken for a gap in coverage. The list covers Yuuri, YUIKA, Ado, King Gnu, back number, LiSA, Official Hige Dandism, Aimer, Kenshi Yonezu, Vaundy, tuki., RADWIMPS and Aimyon. Taiwan and Hong Kong routings in particular remain unannounced for all thirteen, leaving Fujii Kaze as the only confirmed Taiwan date.

market.asOf: 台股＝**2026/10/14（週二）13:30 收盤**；美股＝**2026/10/14（週三）收盤**。　★ **今天兩邊是同一個日曆日，但故事完全相反** —— 台股 **+0.59% 收 48,625.83**，美股那斯達克 **-1.88% 收 26,692.87**。　★ 美股個股漲跌幅取自 10/14 **盤中（midday）** 報導，與最終收盤可能有差異，已於下方逐筆標示。
market.highlight: **一句話：昨天不是 AI 的壞消息，是利率的壞消息 —— 但它先砸在 AI 身上。**美國 9 月 CPI 年增 **3.7%**（預期 3.6%、前值 3.4%），核心 **2.6%** 同樣超預期，汽油單月 **+7.1%**；2 年期殖利率彈 **14 bp 到 4.93%**、10 年期彈 **10 bp 到 5.31%**，美元指數創 18 個月新高約 102.75；市場對 **10/28 FOMC 再升息一碼的機率押到 45%**。結果是**高負債、長回收期的 AI 基建股被集中清算**（CRWV -13.8%、DELL -8.2%、ORCL -6.5%），費半 SOXX **連 7 黑**；而道瓊只跌 0.09%。**台股同日卻收漲 284.52 點 —— 這個背離今天開盤就會被測試。**
market.note: ★ **給你的三個觀察重點（不是建議，是今天開盤該看哪裡）**：　**①台美背離能不能撐住**：台股昨天靠金融與高息股（0056 創新高 +1.79%，是大盤漲幅的三倍）拉抬，AI 權值股其實沒出力（台積電平盤、聯發科 -50 元）。美股 AI 殺盤昨晚才發生，**今天台股開盤才是第一次反映**。　**②AI 伺服器供應鏈是最直接的傳導路徑**：Dell -8.2% 對應到你清單內的緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）、英業達（2356）、廣達（2382）。　**③兩個「非 AI」的警訊別漏看**：Affirm -9.2%（消費信用）與 BAC -7.7%（銀行股在升息預期下反而重挫），這兩筆指向的是**信用品質**，不是 AI 泡沫 —— 性質更嚴重，但發酵更慢。　★ **一個反向訊號**：Halozyme +7.2% 是本日唯一 ≥5% 的上漲標的，資金往生技與防禦型流動，對應你清單內的醫療與防禦型分類。　★ **ASML 的供給面數據請和這段一起讀**（見科技新聞第 3 則）：它說 **AI 需求已超過 2027–28 的機台供給**，客戶甚至想預訂 2029–30。**設備端在喊供不應求、股價端在殺 AI 基建 —— 這兩件事在同一週發生，本身就是今天最值得想的矛盾。**

indices.name: 加權指數 TAIEX
indices.note: 10/14（二）13:30 收盤 · **漲 284.52 點、+0.59%**。　★ **今天最重要的一句話：台股和美股昨天完全走反方向。**同一個交易日，台股收漲 284.52 點，美股那斯達克卻重挫 1.88%、費半連 7 黑。　★ 權值股分歧明顯：**台積電（2330）收 2,490 元、平盤**（尾盤出現賣單，盤中漲幅被洗掉）；鴻海（2317）**243.00 元、漲 3 元**；台達電（2308）**1,785 元、漲 10 元**；廣達（2382）**323 元、平盤**；聯發科（2454）**4,475 元、跌 50 元**。　★ **解讀**：指數上漲靠的不是 AI 權值股 —— 台積電、廣達都只有平盤，聯發科還跌。**上漲動能來自金融與高息族群（見下方 0056）。**這代表昨天是「資金輪動」行情，不是 AI 續強行情。　★ **今天開盤要注意的是：美股昨晚的 AI 殺盤還沒反映到台股，開盤補跌的機率不低。**

indices.name: 元大台灣50 (0050)
indices.note: ⚠️ **本次未取得 10/14 的確認收盤價與漲跌幅**，因此此處**不填數字、標示為示意**，避免你拿一個編造的數字去判斷。　★ **可用的替代判斷**：0050 追蹤台灣 50 指數，與加權指數高度連動；大盤昨日 **+0.59%**，但**權值王台積電平盤、聯發科下跌**，因此 0050 昨日漲幅**大機率小於大盤的 +0.59%**。　★ **建議動作**：要精確數字請直接看下單 App 或 cnyes 個股頁，30 秒可得。

indices.name: 元大高股息 (0056)
indices.note: 10/14（二）**收 59.60 元、+1.79%，再創歷史新高**，盤中一度衝上 **59.70 元**。　★ **今年以來含息報酬已突破 70%** —— 這是昨天台股最強的單一敘事，漲幅（+1.79%）是大盤（+0.59%）的三倍。　★ 助攻個股報導點名**南亞、華南金**，呼應上面「指數靠金融與高息族群拉抬」的判讀。　★ ⚠️ **提醒（陳述事實，非投資建議）**：0056 **即將除息**，創高與除息前買盤有關；**除息後能不能填息是另一回事**，用「今年報酬 70%」當追價理由，在時間點上是有風險的。

indices.name: 道瓊工業指數 Dow Jones
indices.note: 10/14（三）收盤 · **跌 48.62 點、-0.09%**，四大指數中跌最少。　★ **道瓊的「抗跌」本身就是訊息**：它權重偏傳產與金融、科技含量低，所以當殺盤集中在 AI 基建時，道瓊幾乎沒事（-0.09%），那斯達克卻 -1.88%。**兩者差距 1.79 個百分點，是本日最清楚的證據 —— 這不是全面性修正，是 AI 類股被單獨清算。**　★ 但要注意道瓊成分股裡的**美國銀行（BAC）昨天重挫 7.7%**，若金融股續弱，道瓊的保護傘會消失。

indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: 10/14（三）收盤 · **跌 86.51 點、-1.11%**。　★ 位置落在道瓊（-0.09%）與那斯達克（-1.88%）之間，完全符合其成分結構。　★ **觸發事件：美國 9 月 CPI 年增 3.7%，高於預期 3.6%，也高於 8 月的 3.4%**；核心 CPI **2.6%** 同樣高於預期；**汽油單月大漲 7.1%** 是主要推力。　★ 利率市場立即反應：**2 年期殖利率彈 14 個基點到 4.93%、10 年期彈 10 個基點到 5.31%**，美元指數衝上 18 個月新高約 102.75。　★ **市場對 10/28 FOMC「再升息一碼」的機率押到 45%** —— 這是昨天股債匯三殺的真正原因。　★ 白宮經濟顧問 Hassett 稱「這個月的核心通膨只是雜訊（a blip）」，**官方說法與市場定價明顯分歧**。

indices.name: 那斯達克綜合指數 Nasdaq Composite
indices.note: 10/14（三）收盤 · **跌 511.51 點、-1.88%**，四大指數最弱。　★ **費城半導體 SOXX 連續第 7 個交易日下跌** —— 這不是單日事件，是一段已經走了一週半的趨勢，昨天的 CPI 只是把它加速，不是起點。　★ 羅素 2000 同步 **-1.93%（跌 53.84 點、收 2,729.53）**，中小型股與科技股同跌，代表這是**利率驅動的評價殺（折現率上升）**，不是個別公司的基本面問題。　★ **這一點對你很重要**：評價殺的特徵是「跌得快、與獲利無關」，所以不能用「這家公司營收還在成長」來反駁它。

indices.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ)
indices.note: ⚠️ **未取得 QQQ 的確認收盤價**，此處僅以其追蹤的**那斯達克 100 指數昨日約 -1%** 作為示意，**不等於 QQQ 實際收盤漲跌幅**。　★ 一個值得注意的細節：**那斯達克 100（約 -1%）跌得比那斯達克綜合（-1.88%）少** —— 因為綜合指數包含大量中小型、尚未獲利的科技股，它們在利率上升時跌得更兇。**這再次印證了「評價殺」而非「基本面殺」的判讀。**　★ 精確數字請以下單平台為準。

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚今天這一區的資料基準與限制
movers.reason: ★ **今天這一區的核心結論**：**≥5% 的異動全部發生在美股，而且全部集中在「AI 基建／算力租賃／金融科技」這一條線，方向一致向下。**觸發點是 9 月 CPI 3.7% 超預期 → 殖利率飆升 → 高評價、高負債的 AI 基建股被集中清算。　★ **清單內確認 ≥5% 的共 3 檔：Oracle（ORCL）-6.5%、Robinhood（HOOD）-6.2%、IonQ（IONQ）-6%。**　★ **清單外但更該看的是 CoreWeave（CRWV）-13.8%**，它是這波的震央，已依規則放在最上方。　★ ⚠️ **資料限制（請務必讀）**：①美股百分比取自 10/14 **盤中（midday）** 報導，**與最終收盤可能有數個百分點差異** —— Benzinga 自家報價小工具當時顯示 NVDA -2.61%、文內卻是 -1.9%，即為一例；②**台股個股的逐檔確認漲跌幅本次未取得**，因此台股異動區為空狀態，**不以推測數字填充**。

movers.name: CoreWeave
movers.price: 清單外 · AI 算力租賃 · 本日震央
movers.reason: ★ **本日震央，清單外但依規則放在最上方。**單日重挫約 13.8%（開盤即跌 12%，盤中一度 -15%），是全市場最大單日跌幅之一。　★ **為什麼是它**：CoreWeave 的商業模式是「借錢買 GPU、再租出去」，屬於**高負債＋高資本支出＋長回收期**，對利率的敏感度遠高於一般軟體股。CPI 超預期 → 殖利率跳升 → 它的**融資成本與折現率同時變差**，兩頭被夾。　★ **這檔是整條 AI 基建線的領先指標**：若它續跌，Dell、Oracle、IREN、TeraWulf 這一串通常跟著走。

movers.name: DigitalOcean
movers.price: 清單外 · 中小型雲端基建
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -10%。中小型雲端服務商，與 CoreWeave 同屬「利率敏感＋資本密集」族群，被同一套邏輯清算。　★ 它不在你的觀察清單內，列出的理由是：**它確認了這波殺盤的範圍不只龍頭，而是整個雲端基建的中小型股都被無差別賣出。**

movers.name: Fermi
movers.price: 清單外 · AI 資料中心／電力基建
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -9.3%。屬 AI 資料中心與電力基建題材，典型的「故事早、現金流晚」標的，在殖利率跳升的環境下評價壓縮最劇烈。

movers.name: TeraWulf
movers.price: 清單外 · 挖礦轉 AI 算力代管
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -9.3%。原為比特幣挖礦業者、近年轉型 AI 算力代管，**同時承受「加密資產波動」與「AI 基建評價壓縮」兩種風險**，因此跌幅與純算力股同級。　★ 對你的加密貨幣關注面向，這一檔是「礦業→AI」轉型股在升息環境下的實測樣本。

movers.name: Affirm
movers.price: 清單外 · 先買後付 BNPL · 訊號性質不同
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -9.2%。**這一檔的意義和其他人完全不同**：它跌的不是 AI 題材，而是**消費信用**。　★ CPI 3.7% ＋ 汽油單月 +7.1% 意味著家庭可支配所得被擠壓，BNPL 的違約風險上升；同時升息讓它的資金成本變貴，**兩邊一起惡化**。　★ **它是這波唯一明確指向「消費端壓力」的訊號，和 AI 泡沫無關，值得單獨記下來。**

movers.name: IREN
movers.price: 清單外 · 挖礦轉 AI 資料中心
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -8.5%。與 TeraWulf 同一類型、同一邏輯、同步被殺，可視為同族群的交叉驗證。

movers.name: Dell Technologies
movers.price: 清單外 · AI 伺服器 OEM · 對台股最有參考價值
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -8.2%。**這一檔對你的台股觀察清單最有參考價值。**　★ Dell 是 AI 伺服器整機出貨的主要玩家之一，它重挫代表市場開始懷疑**AI 伺服器的出貨量與毛利展望**，而不只是懷疑雲端業者的資本支出。　★ **直接對應到你清單內的台股**：緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）、英業達（2356）、廣達（2382）都在同一條供應鏈上。**今天台股開盤，這一段是最該盯的。**

movers.name: Bank of America
movers.price: 清單外 · 大型銀行 · 本日最該警覺的一筆
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -7.7%。**這是今天最值得警覺的一筆**：在升息預期升高的環境下，銀行股理論上該受惠於利差擴大，卻反而重挫 7.7%。　★ 這通常意味著市場擔心的是**信用品質／放款損失**，而不是利率水準本身。　★ 若這個解讀成立，後續要注意消費貸與商用不動產的資產品質 —— **這與上面 Affirm 的訊號方向完全一致，兩筆互相印證。**

movers.name: Oracle
movers.price: ✅ 清單內（AI雲端）· 清單參考價 149.12
movers.reason: ★ **清單內第 1 檔確認 ≥5%**，單日約 -6.5%。　★ Oracle 近兩年的股價敘事幾乎完全建立在 **OCI／AI cloud 的大額長約**上，而這類合約必須**先投入巨額資本支出**才能認列營收 —— 本質上和 CoreWeave 是同一種財務結構，只是規模大得多。　★ **這解釋了為什麼它跟著 CoreWeave 一起跌 6.5%，而不是像微軟那種成熟雲端股只跌 1–2%。**（陳述事實，非買賣建議。）

movers.name: SoFi Technologies
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 -6.2%。與 Affirm、Robinhood 同屬「散戶金融科技」族群，同時被消費信用惡化與風險偏好下降兩股力量夾擊。

movers.name: Robinhood
movers.price: ✅ 清單內（加密/區塊鏈）· 清單參考價 123.12
movers.reason: ★ **清單內第 2 檔確認 ≥5%**，單日約 -6.2%。　★ Robinhood 的營收高度綁定**散戶交易量與加密交易量**，兩者都是風險偏好的函數。當利率跳升、風險資產下跌時，它等於**同時失去成交量與評價**，因此跌幅是大盤的數倍。　★ **建議一併觀察清單內的 COIN、MSTR、CRCL 是否同向**（本次未取得這三檔的確認漲跌幅，不以推測填入）。

movers.name: IonQ
movers.price: ✅ 清單內（量子電腦）· 清單參考價 39.31
movers.reason: ★ **清單內第 3 檔確認 ≥5%**，單日約 -6%。　★ **但這一檔的跌因和其他人完全不同，是公司自己的事**：IonQ 宣布 **20 億美元的股權增資（附認股權證）**，緊接在 **13 億美元收購 Elisity 的換股案**之後。**連續大額發股＝現有股東被稀釋**，這是直接的基本面利空，不是被大盤拖累。　★ **同族群對照**：D-Wave（QBTS）與 Rigetti（RGTI）同日各跌約 **4%**，**未達 5% 門檻故不列入本表** —— 但三檔同向下跌，顯示量子族群整體在退潮。

movers.name: Halozyme Therapeutics
movers.price: 清單外 · 生技 · 本日唯一上漲 ≥5%
movers.reason: ★ 單日約 **+7.2%，是本日唯一確認漲幅 ≥5% 的標的。**　★ **它的意義在於「反差」**：在一個科技股全面被殺的日子，資金明顯往**生技與防禦型**流動。　★ 這與你清單內「醫療」（LLY、NVO、AMGN）與「防禦型」（JNJ、PG、KO）分類的邏輯一致 —— **若 AI 殺盤延續，這一塊通常是資金的去處。**（陳述觀察，非買賣建議。）
